stops.name: Gerhard Berger
stops.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1990/6/mexican-magic (Berger: 'I came in on lap 13'); https://www.grandprix.com/gpe/rr490.html ('pitted on lap 13'); Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990_Mexican_Grand_Prix
stops.note: blistered left-front; rejoined 12th on Bs left / Cs right

stops.name: Philippe Alliot
stops.note: 'a quick stop for tyres on lap 12'

stops.name: Nelson Piquet
stops.note: 'Prost duplicated Mansell's move on lap 42. Two laps later Nelson dived into the pits' for a set of Cs (vibration)

runningOrder.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990_Mexican_Grand_Prix: 'Senna and Berger both passed Patrese on lap 2, and the McLaren drivers opened a significant lead over the rest of the field ... Berger's run in second place came to an early end when he had to stop for new tyres on lap 13'
https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1990/6/mexican-magic: 'By lap 20 he was 15s ahead of Piquet, who was going like a train in the Benetton'
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990_Mexican_Grand_Prix: 'Berger's run in second place came to an early end when he had to stop for new tyres on lap 13, leaving Piquet in second'

https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1990/6/mexican-magic: 'By the 30 lap mark Piquet's tenancy of second place, keeping Senna honest, was coming under closer scrutiny from Mansell and Prost'
https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1990/6/mexican-magic: '... from Mansell and Prost, who five laps later had worked into third and fourth places.'
https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1990/6/mexican-magic: 'On lap 36 Nigel had a look inside Nelson going into turn one, and made it next time round after a neat slingshot.'
runningOrder.note: Wikipedia has Mansell passing Piquet 'soon afterwards' (after Berger's lap-13 stop); Motor Sport's lap-by-lap account (lap 37) is used

runningOrder.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1990/6/mexican-magic: 'On lap 36 Nigel had a look inside Nelson going into turn one, and made it next time round after a neat slingshot.'
https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1990/6/mexican-magic: 'Prost duplicated Mansell's move on lap 42. Two laps later Nelson dived into the pits'
https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1990/6/mexican-magic: 'by lap 48 the gap between the McLaren and the lead Ferrari was 12.2 seconds'
runningOrder.note: the lead Ferrari at lap 48 is Mansell: Prost took second from him with 15 laps to go (Wikipedia) / on lap 55 (MS)

runningOrder.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1990/6/mexican-magic: 'Ferrari number one slithered into second place' (lap 55); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990_Mexican_Grand_Prix: 'eventually taking second from Mansell with 15 laps to go'
https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1990/6/mexican-magic: 'by lap 62 Senna was eight seconds away from the lead'

notes: Senna (#27) gambled on no stop and retired with a right-rear tyre failure (Wikipedia: three laps after Prost passed him on lap 60; GrandPrix.com: lap 63; Jolpica: 63 laps). Prost (#1) and Mansell (#2): no stop reported in Motor Sport, GrandPrix.com or Wikipedia, but none states they ran non-stop. Larini (#25) 'had also stopped early for fresh rubber' (no lap).
